# WNR Bridal Studio

> Premium South Indian bridal couture house crafting handmade lehengas, bridal sarees, evening gowns, and bespoke wedding wear. Every piece is handcrafted with traditional Aari, Zardosi, and Mirror embroidery.

WNR Bridal Studio is an Indian bridal wear brand based in Chennai, Tamil Nadu. We design and hand-embroider bridal lehengas, sarees, reception gowns, and fully bespoke couture for weddings and special occasions. Orders ship across India, and bespoke commissions are made to measurement.

## Collections

- [Shop All](https://couturemei.com/shop): Browse the full catalogue of bridal and occasion wear.
- [New Arrivals](https://couturemei.com/new-arrivals): The latest Season 2026 pieces.
- [Bridal Lehengas](https://couturemei.com/shop/bridal-lehengas): Handcrafted bridal lehengas with heirloom embroidery.
- [Sarees](https://couturemei.com/shop/sarees): Silk and embroidered bridal sarees.
- [Evening Gowns](https://couturemei.com/shop/evening-gowns): Reception and occasion gowns.
- [Couture](https://couturemei.com/shop/couture): Bespoke, made-to-measure couture.
